prompt: Fetch the reference data over http and count the rows of input/sales.csv, write output/summary.txt

args.command: nohup sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 40); do cat input/sales.csv > /dev/null; echo $i >> output/bg_marker_A.log; sleep 0.25; done' > /dev/null 2>&1 & echo started

for i in $(seq 1 6); do cat input/sales.csv > /dev/null; echo $i > scratch/fg_A_$i.txt; python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(0.2); print('tcp', s.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1', 8000)))"; sleep 0.3; done
for i in $(seq 1 6); do python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); print('uds', s.connect_ex('broker.sock')); s.close()"; cat input/sales.csv > /dev/null; sleep 0.25; done
